finding_title: Rapid Intensification Severe Class Imbalance (2.91% Positive)

impact: Operational model fails completely to detect life-threatening rapid intensification events without weighted loss.
required_correction: Standardize on Class-Ratio Weighted BCE (w = 33.3) or Focal Loss (alpha=0.25, gamma=2.0) for head_ri.

finding_title: Self-Supervised Pretraining Masking Absent Modality Slots
exact_evidence: src/training/pretrain.py applies random 30% masking across all 80 tokens without checking modality presence masks. Radar is absent in 84.6% of overpasses.
impact: Pretraining penalizes the model for reconstructing zeros on missing modalities rather than learning cross-modal representations.
required_correction: Gate random patch masking by the boolean modality presence mask (M_effective = M_rand * M_valid).
